messages:
Emma (AE): quick sync — Acme Health renewal coming up, they want to convert current retainer (monthly support + 100k tokens) into a blended annual commit. asking for 25% discount on list rate and a 60% uplift credit for next 3 months if POC runs over. can we do this without legal/finance loop?
Raj (Sales Eng): how big is their current spend? any SLA changes?
Emma (AE): currently ~$8k/mo on the retainer. target commit is 120k/month equivalent for 12 months. SLA same but they want dedicated pool option later in year.
Lisa (AM): note: they had 2 downtime incidents last q, CS wants clearer SLO language if we take a higher commit.
Miguel (Deal Desk): hill to climb: 25% off list on a committed annual is aggressive for that commit size. can you share target ARR and if they sign a 12+ month PO?
Emma (AE): ARR math: blended list would be $172k/yr, they're asking effective $129k (incl. onboarding credits). they'll sign 12m PO but need finance to approve netting the retainer credit.
Raj (Sales Eng): technical piece: POC might need dedicated instance during proof window. that increases cost; recommend offering a timeboxed trial (30 days) on shared capacity + canary to dedicated if latency spikes.
Nina (Security): FYI their security questionnaire returned with a few new asks: KMS integration confirmation and SOC2 subprocessor list. that needs signoff before private deployment.
Miguel (Deal Desk): two routing options: 1) approve a 15% standard commit discount + one-time onboarding credit to cover retainer delta, OR 2) approve 22% discount if they commit to a 24m term and add a breach clause for SLO credits. which do you prefer?
Emma (AE): preference is option 1 but need fast yes. customer wants headline 25% or they pause. can we get a +manager exceptions approval?
Raj (Sales Eng): if we do option 1, engineering can scope a lightweight dedicated config that keeps cost within the onboarding credit. I'd add a clause: "POC resource cap" to avoid indefinite dedicated usage.
Miguel (Deal Desk): I'll escalate to finance now. pinging legal for contract language.
dealbot: Miguel escalated deal 2070012345 to finance-review queue (priority: high)
Lisa (AM): also adding renewals playbook note — mark this as high-risk churn if we don't meet timeline.
Nina (Security): I'll review KMS wording. ping me tomorrow 10a if legal has contract draft.
Emma (AE): thanks — looping in Raj for tech scoping and Miguel for deal desk. if finance can greenlight the 15% + onboarding credit, I can close by EOW. :crossed_fingers:
Miguel (Deal Desk): quick reference rate snippet I used for sizing:
```
List token rate: $0.015 / 1k tokens
Commit tier 100k+/mo discount band: 15%
Onboarding credit suggestion: $8k one-time
POC dedicated uplift (if needed): ~$2.5k/week
```
Emma (AE): perfect. I'll present option 1 as the fast path and mention option 2 as escalation.
Raj (Sales Eng): I'll prepare a 30-day POC ops checklist and the config limits.
Miguel (Deal Desk): finance said provisional ok to 15% + onboarding credit pending legal contract language and CFO sign-off. updating in CRM.
Emma (AE): awesome — can someone flag the renewal owner in the account so we don't drop handoff?
Lisa (AM): flagging me as renewal owner. adding notes. :white_check_mark:
Emma (AE): great, thanks team — will update customer after legal clears the short amendment.
